name: roosterjs-ado-ext
description: Azure DevOps work item custom control using RoosterJS for System.Description

scripts.build:harness: npm run clean && webpack --mode development --env harness
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npm run check:release && node scripts/package-vsix.mjs && node scripts/verify-vsix.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:build-outputs -- production && npm run build:harness && npm run check:build-outputs -- harness && npm run package:vsix
